title: Stabilize TTFT variance across heterogeneous model variants (hosted/dedicated/private) - emergency hotfix
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Summary: Multiple customers reported sudden first-token latency (TTFT) spikes and decreased tokens/sec on mixed-model endpoints beginning 2026-03-10 03:00 UTC. Affected deployment modes: hosted, Dedicated pools, and private VPC nodes. Symptom pattern: 5–8x TTFT variance for identical requests routed to different model variants; sustained drop in tokens/sec for longer contexts. Incident correlated with a scheduler change (stride prediction tweak) deployed 2026-03-09 that attempted to optimize throughput by aggregating models with similar expected token rates. Root cause hypothesis: the stride heuristic underestimates per-request per-model token emission when models use mixed KV-cache strategies and quantized kernels, causing the router to pack incompatible workloads into the same microbatch window and starve low-latency requests. This produced priority inversion and queue head-of-line blocking for multiplexed workers.
acceptance_criteria: TTFT 95th percentile for affected endpoint returns to baseline (<= 20% above pre-incident) in hosted and Dedicated within 1 hour of rollout
Tokens/sec across long-context workloads recovers to within 10% of baseline for private deployments
No regressions in throughput for synthetic e2e perf suites (multiplex, single-tenant) in CI
Rollback plan validated: manual route-level switch to pre-2026-03-09 stride heuristic within 15 minutes
steps_taken: 2026-03-10 05:40 UTC - Pager hit: customer BrightHealth slack #incidents. Notified on-call.
2026-03-10 06:05 UTC - Initial triage: reproduced spike in staging by replaying production traces; confirmed variance correlated with model_variant_id and kv_cache_mode.
2026-03-10 07:20 UTC - Short-term mitigation: deployed per-model emission_rate override (config flag) on router to simulate historical tokens/sec for critical routes (hosted only).
2026-03-10 09:00 UTC - Monitors: created a Grafana dashboard (link below) with per-model observed_tokens_per_sec and per-route microbatch composition.
2026-03-11 02:30 UTC - Identified scheduler codepath causing mispredictions (stride_predictor_v2) and added telemetry hooks to log estimated vs observed tokens for each scheduled batch.
2026-03-12 11:45 UTC - Hotfix PR created to implement conservative packing: prefer homogeneous kv_cache_mode and kernel_quantization groups when forming microbatches. PR: gh/pr/Redwood/runtime#1289.
2026-03-12 16:00 UTC - Canary rollout to 5% of traffic in us-west-2 Dedicated pools; observed TTFT 95th reduced by 40% for canary traffic in first 30 minutes.
2026-03-13 03:00 UTC - Expanded rollout to staged private customers with opt-in (Ledgeria Systems) and continued monitoring.
2026-03-13 10:30 UTC - Decision: complete rollout stalled due to rare throughput regression on ultra-high-throughput single-tenant jobs; scoped follow-ups to tune batching thresholds.
next_steps: Complete conservative packing rollout cluster-wide once batching thresholds tuned (owner: Marcus Chen; ETA 2026-03-16)
Implement adaptive tokens/sec estimator that uses rolling 1-minute observed rate instead of static model profile (owner: Priya Kapoor; ETA 2026-03-25)
Add e2e perf test that exercises mixed kv_cache_mode + quantized kernels in CI to catch regressions (owner: Evan Walsh; ETA 2026-03-20)
Postmortem and customer communications: draft 72-hour incident note and scheduled customer office hours with impacted accounts (owner: Sofia Patel; ETA 2026-03-14)
Backfill missing telemetry in private control plane logs to enable regression root-cause analysis for air-gapped customers (owner: Platform-SRE; ETA 2026-03-22)
